title: Anterior Thigh Stroking
summary: Long smooth passes over the front of the thigh from above the knee upward.
startingPosition: The leg rests comfortably and relaxed.
instructions: Place the palm on the soft thigh tissue.
Do not press the joint or groin.
direction: From above the knee upward over soft tissue.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, or inflammation. One-sided swelling, redness, warmth, or calf pain should be medically assessed before massage.
